name: Fridays
custom_css: :root { --glass-opacity: 0.85; --glass-blur: 20px; --radius: 8px; } .glass { background: rgba(20, 20, 30, var(--glass-opacity)); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); } .glass-card { background: rgba(28, 28, 36, 0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); padding: 16px; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .glass-card:hover { background: rgba(38, 38, 48, 0.6); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }
